analysis.documentTitle: New Delhi Municipal Council Budget Speech 2026-27
analysis.summary: The New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) Budget Speech 2026-27 presents comprehensive civic budget estimates with total expenditure projected at ₹5,810.02 Crore and total revenue receipts of ₹5,211.92 Crore. Key civic investments focus on Electricity/Discom Operations (₹1,966.80 Crore), Education (₹245.93 Crore), Water Supply (₹230.28 Crore), and Road Infrastructure (₹228.87 Crore).
keyFindings: Total projected budget expenditure for BE 2026-27 is Rs.5810.02 Crore against Rs.5484.15 Crore in RE 2025-26.
Budget Estimates for Revenue Receipts in 2026-27 are Rs.5211.92 Crore.
Capital expenditure is projected at Rs.943.84 Crore in BE 2026-27 against Rs.586.54 Crore in RE 2025-26.
Electricity Department is allocated Rs.1966.80 crore with Rs.360.07 crore towards capital expenditure.
Education Sector is allocated Rs.245.93 crore with Rs.16.99 crore towards capital work.

facts.quote: The total expenditure for BE 2026-27 are Rs.5810.02 Crore
The BE 2026-27 for the revenue receipts are Rs.5211.92 Crore
The capital expenditure is projected at Rs.943.84 Crore in BE 2026-27
The BE for revenue expenditure in 2026-27 are Rs.4866.18 Crore
I propose to allocate Rs.1966.80 crore for Electricity Department
NDMC propose to spend a sum of Rs. 245.93 crore towards Education Sector
I propose to allocate Rs. 228.87 crore for Road Department
I propose to allocate Rs.230.28 crore for Water Supply Department

risks: Peak summer electricity demand management and power procurement tariff fluctuation risks.
Aging underground sewer line infrastructure requiring specialized trenchless rehabilitation.
Water supply dependence on Delhi Jal Board (DJB) raw bulk supply during short periods.
